summary.en: Seiji Ishimoto, president of an electronic company, claims he has been receiving threat letters and hires Kogoro as a bodyguard. As a House of Representatives member gets on stage at the banquet where they're at, he is shot and Seiji's shoulder is grazed. While Takada parades next to Ishimoto, someone takes a photo with their camera, as soon after, a sniper shoots through Ishimoto's arm, nearly missing him, but the bullet lands right in Takada's chest, killing him. Conan spots a man on the balcony, but he is unable to find him. Kogoro spends the night at Seiji's hotel room keeping watch in case the murderer returns. In the morning, Kogoro receives a phonecall from Inspector Megure announcing the man on the balcony was found dead.
